rows.text: when `ecx` is 6 or 9, tail-jumps to `00264CA0` + 0x33 with `ecx` and `edx` unchanged; otherwise calls `00264CA0` + 0x11 with `ecx` and `edx`, returns 0 when its result is negative (signed), and else tail-jumps to `00264CA0` + 0x23 with (that result, the incoming `edx`)

notes: 00264CA0: other direct sites `00352C80` + 0x2B and `003532D0` + 0x2B. On the 6/9 path r8d also holds the incoming edx.
